title: Fire Sale Voices

heading: Fire Sale: voices
intro: Round 2: five new Jims, all Essex, read plain (round 1 had a delivery style added, which made it acting). Phineas a and BadCode b are Kai's picks and are in the cut. My Jim pick is a (Basildon), a guess from the descriptions because I can't hear them: overrule it here.

sections.lede: Claude can't hear these: its picks are guesses from the descriptions.

groups.title: Jim, round 2: Essex
groups.line: "Hospitals, love. Forty quid." / "The courts. Slightly used."

opts.label: a: Basildon, mild Essex, low and a bit rough (my pick)
b: Debden estate, East End parents, deep and gravelly
c: Southend, light Estuary, medium-low and husky
d: Harlow builder, low and a bit hoarse
e: Grays, Tilbury docks, low and flat
